title: Jimmy Carter exposes the stealth program

tellings.quote: happened to Jimmy Carter when he was trying to get reelected. He mentioned the stealth

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1980, while President Jimmy Carter was running for reelection, Carter publicly mentioned the stealth program, the secret effort to build aircraft that are hard to spot on radar, linked to Burbank, California. Cameron tells it as an example of a president letting out a guarded secret, and of what happens to someone who does.
